verses.text: Moses said to the leaders of the tribes of Israel, "This is what the LORD has commanded:
When a man makes a special promise to the LORD, or swears an oath that binds him to do something, he must not break his word. He must do everything he said.
When a young woman still living in her father's house makes a promise to the LORD or binds herself to do something,
and her father hears about her promise or her pledge but says nothing to her, then all her promises and every pledge she made must be kept.
But if her father forbids it on the day he hears about it, none of her promises or pledges have to be kept. The LORD will forgive her, because her father stopped her.
If she gets married while she is still bound by a promise, or by a careless pledge she made,
and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her on the day he hears, then her promises and pledges must be kept.
But if her husband forbids it on the day he hears about it, he cancels the promise she made and the careless pledge she spoke. The LORD will forgive her.
Any promise or pledge made by a widow or a divorced woman must be kept.
If a married woman makes a promise or binds herself with an oath while living in her husband's house,
and her husband hears about it but says nothing to her and does not forbid it, then all her promises and every pledge she made must be kept.
But if her husband cancels them on the day he hears about them, then none of the promises or pledges she spoke have to be kept. Her husband has cancelled them, and the LORD will forgive her.
Her husband may allow or cancel any promise she makes, and any pledge to go without things.
But if her husband says nothing to her about it from one day to the next, then he has allowed all her promises and pledges. He has agreed to them by saying nothing on the day he heard about them.
If he cancels them some time after he hears about them, he will carry the blame for her broken promise."
These are the rules the LORD gave Moses about a man and his wife, and about a father and his young daughter still living in his house.
